{"id":1180600686,"question_id":44,"lang":"csharp","lang_name":"C#","time":"2 years, 5 months","timestamp":1708405837,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"81 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1180600686/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Wildcard Matching","memory":"52.5 MB","code":"public class Solution {\n    public bool IsMatch(string s, string p) {\n        if(s == p)\n        {\n            return true;\n        }\n        int n = p.Length;\n        int m = s.Length;\n        bool[,] dp = new bool[n+1,m+1];\n\n        dp[0,0] = true;\n\n        for(int i = 1; i<=n; i++)\n        {\n            if(p[i-1] == '*')\n            {\n                dp[i,0] = dp[i-1,0];\n            }\n        }\n\n        for(int i = 1; i<=n; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = 1; j<= m; j++)\n            {\n                if(p[i-1] == '*')\n                {\n                    dp[i,j] = dp[i-1,j] || dp[i,j-1];\n                }\n                else\n                {\n                    if(s[j-1] == p[i-1] || p[i-1] == '?')\n                    {\n                        dp[i,j] = dp[i-1,j-1];\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            \n        }\n\n        return dp[n,m];\n    }\n}","compare_result":"","title_slug":"wildcard-matching","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":349}
